decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Historic Building Impact Assessment and Report by Andrzej Woloszczuk dated 8th March 2016
 Development History of Lingard House by Ellen Leslie
LH-PRE-SK-04 Rev C, LH-PRE-SK-05 Rev C, LH-PRE-SK-06 Rev C, LH-07 Rev A, Flood risk assessment ref. LH-FRA-01A, LH-PRE-SK-03 Rev C, LH-PRE-SK-02 Rev C, LH-PRE-SK-01 Rev C Received 15/3/16 
 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the original building.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any external feature, except in so far as the repairs hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Erection of a new flat roof, new windows and rooflights together with internal and external restoration and refurbishment
